conclusions.summary: The async-await-type-safety specification is fully enforced with NO RIPPLE CHANGES NEEDED. All changes made during the enforcement phase were comprehensive and consistent across all components. Conflict analysis detected 0 conflicts. Validation confirms 7/7 configuration checks pass (100%). The 2 runtime check failures are due to missing dependencies (pyright, pytest), not actual enforcement issues. The specification is production-ready and will prevent the 3 async/await bugs (Mar 2-4, 2026) from recurring.
